Cutting out intermediaries lets us tailor coverage to how companies actually operate and price risk more efficiently.We build insurance products from the ground up, using AI and software to automate the workflows traditionally handled by large teams of brokers, underwriters, TPAs, accountants, and operations staff. Our goal is not to incrementally improve insurance, it is to rebuild the industry infrastructure itself.We move quickly, care deeply about talent density, and hire people who want to solve difficult problems with unusually high ownership.About the RoleWe're hiring an Applied AI Engineer to build and deploy AI systems that power our insurance companies and internal operations.You will work closely with engineering, product, operations, and leadership to develop AI-powered products and automate complex workflows across underwriting, claims, finance, compliance, and internal tooling. title: Senior AI & Automation Engineer
description: Chcesz budować rozwiązania AI, które nie kończą się na proof of concept, ale rzeczywiście trafiają na produkcję i wspierają procesy biznesowe?Szukamy Senior AI & Automation Engineera, który połączy mocne kompetencje techniczne z wpływem na kierunek rozwoju naszych rozwiązań AI. To rola dla osoby, która chce nadal pracować hands-on, a jednocześnie dzielić się wiedzą, koordynować pracę niewielkiego zespołu i współdecydować o standardach technologicznych.Twoja rolaBędziesz projektować i rozwijać rozwiązania AI oraz automatyzacje end-to-end: od proof of concept, przez trenowanie i wdrażanie modeli, aż po ich utrzymanie i monitoring na produkcji.Na co dzień będziesz współpracować z developerami i trenerami AI, zespołem platformy Azure AI, Product Ownerami, architektami oraz zespołami biznesowymi. Będziesz mieć również realny wpływ na roadmapę oraz standardy dotyczące rozwoju AI i automatyzacji.Twoje zadaniaProjektowanie, rozwój i wdrażanie rozwiązań AI: modeli ML/LLM, agentów AI oraz automatyzacji procesów biznesowych, wraz z ich utrzymaniem na produkcji.Trenowanie, fine-tuning i ewaluacja modeli oraz budowa zbiorów danych, metryk jakości i mechanizmów human-in-the-loop.Projektowanie architektury rozwiązań agentowych w Azure AI Foundry oraz ich integracja z systemami firmy poprzez REST API.Wyznaczanie standardów technicznych i dobrych praktyk w obszarze AI, MLOps/LLMOps, bezpieczeństwa, monitoringu, wersjonowania modeli, kontroli dryfu oraz optymalizacji kosztów.Koordynowanie pracy niewielkiego zespołu developerów i trenerów AI: planowanie zadań, code review, mentoring oraz udział w rekrutacji.Współtworzenie roadmapy rozwiązań AI i automatyzacji wspólnie z Product Ownerami oraz współpraca z zespołem platformy Azure AI, architektami, zespołami ERP, bezpieczeństwa i biznesem.Tam, gdzie rozwiązania low-code będą najlepszym wyborem, będziesz również wykorzystywać Power Platform, w szczególności Power Automate i Power Apps.Wymagania:Minimum 4 lata doświadczenia w roli developera lub ML Engineera, w tym co najmniej rok pracy przy projektach AI/ML lub LLM.Bardzo dobra znajomość Pythona i doświadczenie w tworzeniu produkcyjnych rozwiązań.Praktyczne doświadczenie z usługami Azure, w szczególności Azure Functions, Azure AI Foundry i Azure Databricks.Doświadczenie w pracy z LLM i rozwiązaniami agentowymi, w tym prompt engineeringiem i RAG oraz narzędziami lub frameworkami takimi jak Azure AI Agent Service, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, LangChain czy LangGraph.Doświadczenie w trenowaniu, fine-tuningu i ewaluacji modeli oraz znajomość podejścia MLOps/LLMOps.Umiejętność projektowania i budowania REST API oraz znajomość baz danych SQL. Dodatkowym atutem będzie doświadczenie z bazami wektorowymi lub Azure AI Search.Znajomość Power Platform, szczególnie Power Automate i Power Apps.Doświadczenie w roli Tech Leada lub mentora albo gotowość do przejęcia odpowiedzialności za techniczną koordynację niewielkiego zespołu.Umiejętność przekładania potrzeb biznesowych na rozwiązania techniczne oraz swobodnej komunikacji z osobami nietechnicznymi.Znajomość języka angielskiego na poziomie minimum B2.Co będzie ważne w tej roli?Szukamy osoby, która nie tylko zna technologie AI, ale potrafi podejmować świadome decyzje dotyczące ich zastosowania. Kogoś, kto potrafi ocenić, kiedy warto wykorzystać LLM, rozwiązanie agentowe czy klasyczny model ML, a kiedy prostsza automatyzacja będzie lepszym i bardziej efektywnym rozwiązaniem.Jeśli lubisz łączyć hands-on development, AI engineering i techniczny leadership, jednocześnie mając wpływ na to, jak rozwiązania AI są projektowane i rozwijane w organizacji, ta rola może być dla Ciebie.Oferujemy:Stabilne warunki zatrudnienia i przyjazna atmosfera pracy.Pracę hybrydową z naszego biura, znajdującego się w Galerii Młociny (2/3 dni tygodniowo)Możliwość rozwoju zawodowego w strukturach wewnętrznych.Możliwość skorzystania z benefitów pozapłacowych na preferencyjnych warunkach.Możliwość współpracy z zespołem ekspertów.Zniżkę pracowniczą na części samochodowe grupy Inter Cars.Szkolenia wewnętrzne i zewnętrzne rozwijające Show more Show less

description: Who are we:Core Insurance Platforms (CIP) is Zurich’s global capability responsible for building, running, and evolving core insurance technology. We set a unified, scalable operating model—covering governance, standards, architecture, service delivery, and reuse—so our business units can deliver at speed and scale.CIP is the strategic steward of Zurich’s Guidewire ecosystem, aligning platform roadmaps to business strategy while driving stability, modernization, reduced supplier dependency, and long term cost efficiency.India delivery center is one of our global delivery and capability hub. We bring together experts in AI, engineering, analysis, quality, and architecture to deliver product & process solutions, application run services, change and transformation initiatives, and centralized platform services across both on prem and Guidewire Cloud environments. Our teams operate from multiple global delivery centers, supporting Zurich’s business units worldwide.Intelligent Automation EngineerOur talent matters:At Zurich, we are passionate about cultivating our talent. Our culture creates an environment where everyone is encouraged to get involved and be inspired at every stage of your career.Zurich is committed to developing a sustainable workforce – we support employees to explore opportunities that will enhance their talents – we have career pathwaysWe created a ‘Customer Academy’, to help people learn new skills through a range of topicsOur award-winning Female Leadership, Aspiring Leaders and Manager Excellence Programs all help grow our talented employees We have other various training programs that helps and supports you be the best you can be in your chosen fieldOur FlexWork@Zurich policy empowers you to work where, when and how you choose while balancing this with business and team priorities.We are committed to help you thrive as you share your ideas, initiatives, and energy. You have the chance to work with global, diverse, and inclusive teams as you develop valuable skills, explore your passions, and make a positive impact beyond your role.The adventure we’re on at Zurich:We take pride in uniting our people within an energized culture that empowers everyone to focus on what matters most to our customers, partners and each other. This is an exciting time to be at Zurich as we empower our people to fuel innovation and collaborate across diverse teams. At Zurich we encourage everyone to be curious, courageous and responsible as we seek out new opportunities to deliver value and delight for our customers. We know we can achieve great things when we put our mind to it. Zurich is a place that you can truly belong and thrive!About the business:The Intelligent Automation team within [insert relevant business segment/unit] focuses on scaling secure, enterprise grade automation and AI driven solutions across the organization. We use the Microsoft Power Platform and Microsoft AI Services to digitize manual processes, improve customer and employee experiences, and support more efficient, risk aware and data driven operations. The team works closely with business stakeholders, IT, data and risk functions to deliver practical, sustainable automation outcomes.About this role:A great opportunity exists as Intelligent Automation Engineer, reporting to Chapter Lead – Intelligent Automation Engineering.In this hands on engineering role, you design, build and support automation and AI solutions using Microsoft Power Platform, Azure, PowerFX, SQL and AI Builder. You translate business requirements into secure, robust and maintainable applications, workflows and AI enabled agents, working within an Agile delivery squad. You focus on operational delivery rather than defining overall strategy. Your work enables business teams and citizen developers to safely use low code tools within established governance and architectural guardrails, helping the organization scale intelligent automation in a controlled, sustainable way.Key responsibilities:Design, develop and deploy solutions on Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio, Dataverse) to digitize and automate business processes. Implement AI enabled features using AI Builder and Azure AI capabilities (e.g. Azure OpenAI, Azure Cognitive Services, Azure AI Studio) to enhance applications and workflows with intelligent capabilities. Build and maintain integrations between Power Platform solutions and enterprise data/systems (e.g. Snowflake, SQL, Azure services, CRM/ERP, REST APIs) in line with security and compliance requirements. Provide operational support for existing automations, including monitoring, incident resolution, minor enhancements and performance tuning. Apply secure by design principles, Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) and CI/CD practices, using tools such as Azure DevOps for version control and deployments across environments. Produce and maintain clear technical documentation (designs, runbooks, support guides) to support audit, handover and ongoing maintenance. Collaborate in Agile squads with product owners, business analysts, developers and other stakeholders to refine requirements, estimate effort and deliver against agreed priorities. Contribute reusable components, patterns and guidance to support citizen development and ensure solutions built by business users respect agreed guardrails. Stay up to date with new capabilities in Power Platform and Azure (including PowerFX, AI Builder and related services) and suggest improvements or new use cases where they add value.Ensure the wellbeing of team members and proactively work to identify and manage workplace exposures which may precipitate workplace stress, bullying, harassment, and discrimination. Important to your success:Practical, hands on experience with Microsoft Power Platform in an enterprise context, including Power Apps (canvas and/or model driven), Power Automate and Copilot Studio; experience with Dataverse is highly valued. Exposure to AI Builder and Azure AI capabilities (e.g. Azure OpenAI, Azure Cognitive Services, Azure AI Studio) and an understanding of how to embed AI capabilities into business applications and workflows within responsible AI and governance frameworks. Good understanding of software engineering fundamentals: modular design, reusability, maintainability, error handling, logging and testing. Experience with CI/CD, ALM and DevOps practices for low code solutions, ideally using Azure DevOps and Git for version control, pipelines and environment management. Foundational knowledge of data and integration concepts, including REST APIs, JSON, OAuth and integration with data platforms such as Snowflake, SQL or other cloud data stores. Familiarity with cloud concepts and relevant Azure services (e.g. Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Key Vault, messaging services) used alongside Power Platform. Experience working in Agile teams (Scrum/Kanban), with the ability to translate business requirements into user stories and technical designs, and to communicate clearly with both technical and non technical stakeholders. Strong sense of ownership, reliability and attention to detail, with the ability to balance new development work and ongoing support for existing solutions. Curiosity and willingness to learn new Power Platform and AI features, share knowledge, and contribute to communities of practice and continuous improvement initiatives.We are here to support your needsAs a leader in the insurance industry, we embrace the development needs of our employees to ensure they can achieve success and thrive in the workplace. Zurich is committed to ensuring that our process is fair and accessible for all candidates. If you require special accommodations to participate in our recruitment process, we encourage you to let us know at the time of your application.A new Zurich adventure awaits youIf you’re interested in being part of our adventure that will build a brighter future together, and feel a sense of togetherness, then we look forward to you starting your adventure with us!
